Func.Pkg.limits: Native word positions and raw object names. Lean abstracts package, signature, object, type and value identities with tokens and observes generic success or panic. Native distinguishes nil and typed nil and runs synthetic signature/receiver states where applicable. Fresh allocation identity, constructor zero-valued fields not represented in Lean, and function flags are native observations. Allocator implementation and panic diagnostics are outside scope.
